# CGE-Core v0.8.0

v0.8.0 is the architecture-consolidation release: one canonical package
layout, one notebook course, and no duplicated historical redirect surface.

## Install

```bash
pip install "https://github.com/miraflor/CGE-core/releases/download/v0.8.0/cge_core-0.8.0-py3-none-any.whl"
```

## What changed

- Historical redirect modules were removed from the active package.
- The inherited PyCGE engine now lives at `cge_core._pycge`; `from cge_core import PyCGE` remains supported.
- IFPRI implementation APIs now live only under `cge_core.models.ifpri`.
- Experimental Python authoring and `.cge.md` now live only under `cge_core.experimental`.
- The notebook directory contains exactly the seven canonical lessons.
- Internal duplicate mutation/comparison/account logic was consolidated.

See `docs/migration-v0.8.md` for import-path changes.

No validated Hosoe, CAMCGE, or IFPRI economic equations are intentionally changed by this release.
